When educating residents about the potential effects of radiation exposure through CT ordering practices, most clinicians may not change their approach. Radiation education allows clinicians to discuss the benefits and risks associated with CT scans, leading to more informed decisions about ordering these tests for patients.

Education can improve clinician-patient discussions around CT scan utilization, potentially altering practice patterns in certain situations. However, it is unlikely that residents will change their own practices without additional guidance or support from radiologists or other healthcare professionals involved in the patient's care.
